_comment: Codex-specific hooks merged over the git-sync SessionStart (which is derived from global-settings.json). These replicate Claude Code's agent-activity logging, but self-source path/id from the stdin payload because Codex does not inject OCTO_HOOK_FILE / OCTO_AGENT_ID. Each event appends its raw hook JSON (plus aid = agent_id||session_id and ts = UTC timestamp) to ~/.octo-activity/codex/<session_id>.jsonl for octo tooling to tail.

hooks.command: inp=$(cat); sid=$(printf '%s' "$inp" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); aid=$(printf '%s' "$inp" | jq -r '.agent_id // .session_id // "unknown"'); f="$HOME/.octo-activity/codex/$sid.jsonl"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$f")"; ( flock -x -w 5 9; printf '%s' "$inp" | jq -c --arg aid "$aid" --arg ts "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" '. + {aid:$aid, ts:$ts}' >> "$f" ) 9>"$f.lock" 2>/dev/null || true
